title: Mushroom and spinach eggs on toast

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Butter, mushrooms, garlic, spinach, eggs, bread and fresh herbs are all plain home kitchen foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a large lidded frying pan and a toaster or grill, and the technique is simple.

works.reason: 400g mushrooms, 200g spinach, eight eggs and four slices of toast make a sensible breakfast for four, and the timings and heat are clear.

honest_times.reason: About 20 minutes in total, covering slicing, frying and cooking the eggs, is believable and fits a quick pace.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, nothing unlisted appears, and wholemeal bread matches the bread id.

seasonal_feel.reason: Mushrooms lead this warm May breakfast, with spinach and garden herbs that are in season.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Eggs, mushrooms and spinach on wholemeal toast make a filling, wholesome breakfast.
